svg.title: Where recorded code vocabularies stopped expanding
svg.desc: For each field, the last new code in its retained observation or batch sequence. The pale remainder contains no further new codes; this does not establish saturation.

text.tspan: Where did the recorded vocabulary stop expanding?
Colour ends at the last new code. The pale remainder reuses codes already encountered.
